project.name: Java AI Rosetta :: 05 Memory
project.description: Conversational memory: a /chat endpoint that remembers a conversation and keeps conversations isolated, kept in memory (Spring AI MessageChatMemoryAdvisor / LangChain4j ChatMemoryProvider) and persisted to Qdrant (Spring AI VectorStoreChatMemoryAdvisor / a hand-rolled LangChain4j ChatMemoryStore), across Spring AI on Spring Boot, LangChain4j on Spring Boot, and LangChain4j on Quarkus.
